Bassist and composer Chuck Israels was born in New York City on August 10, 1936. He has performed and recorded with a diverse roster of jazz luminaries including John Coltrane, Herbie Hancock, and Bill Evans. Chuck directed the National Jazz Ensemble from 1973 to 1981 and he currently directs a jazz nonet in Portland, Oregon.
Chuck was interviewed via Zoom on June 11, 2021 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive at Hamilton College and I’m very pleased to have Chuck Israels with me today. Welcome, sir.
Thank you. Glad to be here. Glad somebody’s interested in something for a minute.
